is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus s.s. and Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Page 3, Section 2.2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for GSTe2 L119F, Rdl A296S, and Vgsc L1014S (kdr-east) (Page 6, Section 2.6; Page 7, Section 2.7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) are provided for the L119F mutation in An. funestus (Page 6, Section 2.6, Figure 4A).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field sites in Busia and Mayuge, Uganda (Page 9, Section 4.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting original field collection and laboratory analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies villages: Bumanji (Busia) and Bubbalya (Mayuge) (Page 9, Section 4.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were performed in February 2020 (Page 9, Section 4.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections performed in 2020.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes pyrethroid resistance in Anopheles funestus and Anopheles gambiae from Busia and Mayuge, Uganda. It reports high resistance intensity, reduced efficacy of LLINs, and genotypes resistance markers including GSTe2 L119F, Rdl A296S, and Vgsc L1014S.
